name: Sidebar Controls
description: Adds buttons that collapse the file tree and the right sidebar, and can push the sidebar to the right edge of the window.
author: Ole Eskild Steensen

settings.name: Toggle file tree
settings.description: Show a button that collapses the file tree on the left.

settings.name: Toggle right sidebar
settings.description: Show a button that collapses the right sidebar (graph, table of contents, backlinks).

settings.name: Button position
settings.description: Put the buttons in the top corners next to each sidebar, or in the floating button stack in the bottom-right corner.

settings.name: Right sidebar position
settings.description: Keep the right sidebar next to the note, or push it all the way to the right edge of the window. Applies on screens wider than 1400px.

settings.name: Remember state
settings.description: Keep sidebars collapsed across pages and visits for each reader.
